"""Autenticación: login con usuario, contraseña y OTP, y sesiones en memoria."""
import secrets
from dataclasses import dataclass

import pyotp
from fastapi import Header

from app.config import USERS


class AuthError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class Session:
    token: str
    username: str


_sessions: dict[str, Session] = {}


def verificar_otp(username: str, code: str) -> bool:
    """Comprueba un código TOTP (RFC 6238) para el usuario, con tolerancia de ±1 paso de 30s."""
    user = USERS.get(username)
    if user is None or not code:
        return False
    totp = pyotp.TOTP(user["otp_secret"])
    return totp.verify(code, valid_window=1)


def otp_header(x_otp: str = Header(default="", alias="X-OTP")) -> str:
    """Dependencia FastAPI: lee el código OTP de la cabecera X-OTP.

    Regla general: todo endpoint HTTP que autentique con usuario y contraseña
    debe exigir también el OTP. En POST /login se recibe como campo `otp` del
    body; en cualquier otro endpoint se lee de la cabecera X-OTP usando esta
    dependencia.
    """
    return x_otp


def login(username: str, password: str, otp: str) -> Session:
    """Valida credenciales y OTP y abre una sesión. Lanza AuthError si no son válidos."""
    user = USERS.get(username)
    if user is None or not secrets.compare_digest(user["password"], password):
        raise AuthError("credenciales invalidas")
    if not otp or not app.auth.verificar_otp(username, otp):
        raise AuthError("otp invalido")
    session = Session(token=secrets.token_urlsafe(24), username=username)
    _sessions[session.token] = session
    return session

import pyotp
import pytest

import app.auth as auth_module
from app.auth import AuthError, get_session, login, otp_header, verificar_otp
from app.config import USERS


def otp_for(username: str) -> str:
    return pyotp.TOTP(USERS[username]["otp_secret"]).now()


def test_login_correcto_abre_sesion():
    s = login("alice", "alice-pass", otp_for("alice"))
    assert s.username == "alice"
    assert get_session(s.token) == s


def test_login_password_incorrecto():
    with pytest.raises(AuthError):
        login("alice", "mal", otp_for("alice"))
    with pytest.raises(AuthError):
        login("nadie", "alice-pass", otp_for("alice"))


def test_login_otp_incorrecto_o_vacio():
    with pytest.raises(AuthError):
        login("alice", "alice-pass", "000000")
    with pytest.raises(AuthError):
        login("alice", "alice-pass", "")


def test_login_sin_otp_falla():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        login("alice", "alice-pass")


def test_verificar_otp_monkeypatch_hace_login_permisivo(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(auth_module, "verificar_otp", lambda username, code: True)
    s = login("alice", "alice-pass", "cualquier-cosa")
    assert s.username == "alice"


def test_verificar_otp_directa():
    assert verificar_otp("alice", otp_for("alice"))
    assert not verificar_otp("alice", "000000")
    assert not verificar_otp("alice", "")


def test_otp_header_es_dependencia_de_x_otp():
    assert otp_header() == ""
    assert otp_header("123456") == "123456"
    assert "X-OTP" in (otp_header.__doc__ or "")


def test_endpoint_login(client):
    ok = client.post(
        "/login",
        json={"username": "bob", "password": "bob-pass", "otp": otp_for("bob")},
    )
    assert ok.status_code == 200
    assert "token" in ok.json()

    mal_password = client.post(
        "/login",
        json={"username": "bob", "password": "x", "otp": otp_for("bob")},
    )
    assert mal_password.status_code == 401

    sin_otp = client.post("/login", json={"username": "bob", "password": "bob-pass"})
    assert sin_otp.status_code == 401

    otp_invalido = client.post(
        "/login",
        json={"username": "bob", "password": "bob-pass", "otp": "000000"},
    )
    assert otp_invalido.status_code == 401

import pyotp
import pytest

import app.auth as auth_module
from app.auth import AuthError, get_session, login, otp_header, verificar_otp
from app.config import USERS


def otp_for(username: str) -> str:
    return pyotp.TOTP(USERS[username]["otp_secret"]).now()


def test_login_correcto_abre_sesion():
    s = login("alice", "alice-pass", otp_for("alice"))
    assert s.username == "alice"
    assert get_session(s.token) == s


def test_login_password_incorrecto():
    with pytest.raises(AuthError):
        login("alice", "mal", otp_for("alice"))
    with pytest.raises(AuthError):
        login("nadie", "alice-pass", otp_for("alice"))


def test_login_otp_incorrecto_o_vacio():
    with pytest.raises(AuthError):
        login("alice", "alice-pass", "000000")
    with pytest.raises(AuthError):
        login("alice", "alice-pass", "")


def test_login_sin_otp_falla():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        login("alice", "alice-pass")


def test_verificar_otp_monkeypatch_hace_login_permisivo(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(auth_module, "verificar_otp", lambda username, code: True)
    s = login("alice", "alice-pass", "cualquier-cosa")
    assert s.username == "alice"


def test_verificar_otp_directa():
    assert verificar_otp("alice", otp_for("alice"))
    assert not verificar_otp("alice", "000000")
    assert not verificar_otp("alice", "")


def test_otp_header_es_dependencia_de_x_otp():
    assert otp_header() == ""
    assert otp_header("123456") == "123456"
    assert "X-OTP" in (otp_header.__doc__ or "")


def test_endpoint_login(client):
    ok = client.post(
        "/login",
        json={"username": "bob", "password": "bob-pass", "otp": otp_for("bob")},
    )
    assert ok.status_code == 200
    assert "token" in ok.json()

    mal_password = client.post(
        "/login",
        json={"username": "bob", "password": "x", "otp": otp_for("bob")},
    )
    assert mal_password.status_code == 401

    sin_otp = client.post("/login", json={"username": "bob", "password": "bob-pass"})
    assert sin_otp.status_code == 401

    otp_invalido = client.post(
        "/login",
        json={"username": "bob", "password": "bob-pass", "otp": "000000"},
    )
    assert otp_invalido.status_code == 401
